biotools.summary: CapMux is a Snakemake pipeline designed to process split-pool scRNA-seq data. It reconstructs sample identity from raw sequencing files (BCL or FASTQ) to yield sample-resolved outputs for subsequent analysis.
biotools.name: CapMux: Snakemake pipeline for scRNA-seq demultiplexing
